admin.tmdbDesc: Server-side poster cache — disk usage, free space, and manual clear.
admin.tmdbHowItWorks: First request fetches the image from TMDB, resizes it to WebP, and saves it on this server. Poster cards, hero backdrops, and title logos all use this cache. Later requests are served from disk for 24 hours. A daily cron deletes files older than 1 day. If the cache fails, browsers fall back to image.tmdb.org.
admin.tmdbPruneScheduleDesc: Choose how often old poster files are deleted (older than 24 hours). Time uses server local timezone.
admin.tmdbScheduleSaved: Prune schedule saved and cron updated
admin.tmdbCronOutOfSync: Differs from saved schedule — click Save schedule
